<p align="center"><strong>Restore the pump to reach the spare copper coil.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">Black water covers the stone floor. A dry raised walkway leads to the idle pump. Your light catches faces under the surface; they disappear before you can count them.</p>

<p align="center">The copper coil rests above a cabinet across the flooded section. Three loose fuses wait by the pump. You need the water lowered to reach it.</p>

<p align="center">Your cat stays on your shoulder. From the water, another cat calls in exactly its voice.</p>
